verdict.label: within_bounds
verdict.rule: E1(x, R) = 2*mean_r||x - r|| - mean_{r != r'}||r - r'|| on L2-normalised BSE embeddings, R = Batch_3 training images other than x; band = 95/99 % quantiles (numpy linear) of E1 for each Batch_3 image against the other Batch_3 images in R. within_bounds if E1 <= band95, investigate if band95 < E1 <= band99, outside_bounds if E1 > band99; matches_known_batch = E1 <= band99. The flag never replaces pred_batch.
verdict.reason: Bet Batch_3 with p=0.959 (runner-up Batch_2 p=0.040, margin 0.920); tier high because p_max=0.959 >= 0.75 and LOIO permutation p=0.0350 < 0.05. Top drivers: embedding PC 1 (+2.66), embedding PC 4 (+0.43), F01_c0_area_fraction (+0.36). Most top drivers are embedding components, whose batch signal could not be separated from acquisition in Phase B; the bet stands. Batch_3 embedding check: E1=0.1910 vs band95 0.2225 / band99 0.2389 -> within_bounds. Acquisition covariates outside the training 5-95 % range: curtaining_score_BSE, hstripe_score_BSE.

closed_set.note: assumes the image is from one of the known batches

justification.rule: pred_batch = argmax of the image's predicted probability (out-of-fold for training images); always one of Batch_1, Batch_2, Batch_3. confidence = that probability; margin = top minus runner-up. Tier: low if p_max < 0.5, or LOIO permutation p >= 0.05, or OOD label = outside_bounds; medium if 0.5 <= p_max < 0.75; high if p_max >= 0.75 and LOIO permutation p < 0.05. Model: StandardScaler(F01-F11) + PCA(n_components=29, svd_solver='full') of the raw mean-pooled BSE DINOv2 embedding, both fitted on the training images only; LogisticRegression(C=1.0, class_weight='balanced', solver='lbfgs', max_iter=10000, random_state=0), L2, multinomial.
